nodes.name: Error Trigger
nodes.notes: Set this workflow as the "Error Workflow" in every other workflow's settings. n8n then routes any unhandled failure here.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ workflow: $json.workflow, errorCode: $json.errorCode, errorMessage: $json.errorMessage, subject: $json.node, execution: { id: $json.executionId } }) }}

nodes.name: Backend: Log + Alert
nodes.notes: The backend writes workflow_executions and posts the single "⚠️ Automation Failed" Slack alert. Centralising it here means one format and no duplicate pages.

parameters.jsCode:
console.log('Failure recorded and alerted:', JSON.stringify($json.body ?? {}));
return [$input.first()];

nodes.name: Slack: Direct Alert (backend down)
nodes.notes: Last resort. If the backend is down it cannot alert anyone about itself, so this path posts to Slack directly from n8n.

meta.description: Set as the Error Workflow on all other UrbanCart workflows.
